title: Any Minute Now by Alix Sobler at HERE Arts Center #anyminutenow #here...
transcript: Any Minute Now is living proof that you don't need a big budget to make entertaining theatre. This new play by Alix Sobler depicts an unexpected reunion for three family members unfolding over a single scene in just one room. The inciting event is related to time travel but that's really just the device used to rehash relationships and old wounds. Beyond showing us the circumstances of these specific characters, the play juxtaposes the timelessness of certain struggles with the bewildering fact that everything about life as we know it has changed in just a few decades. In addition to flexing some great acting and chemistry among the performers, it is the perfect length, in part due to its tactical restraint. I'm always impressed when a playwright knows when to avoid opening up a can of worms, and even though this play could have gone further in any number of directions, it stays focused while leaving plenty up for interpretation. What we get as an audience is a captivating experience from start to finish and a nice conversation piece for afterwards. With that, another program for my collection.
